title: ZX Bank ATM Locations at Major Railway Stations and Airports

nodes.title: 1. **Mumbai, Maharashtra**
nodes.summary: 24x7 ATMs at Mumbai railway stations Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), Mumbai Central, Dadar and Lokmanya Tilak Terminus, and at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (Terminals 1 & 2).

nodes.title: 2. **Delhi, National Capital Territory**
nodes.summary: 24x7 ATMs at Delhi railway stations New Delhi (NDLS), Hazrat Nizamuddin (NZM), Old Delhi Junction (DLI) and Anand Vihar Terminal, and at Indira Gandhi International Airport (Terminals 1, 2, 3).

nodes.title: 3. **Bangalore (Bengaluru), Karnataka**
nodes.summary: 24x7 ATMs at Bangalore railway stations Krantivira Sangolli Rayanna (Bengaluru City Junction - SBC) and Yeshwanthpur Junction, and at Kempegowda International Airport.

nodes.title: 4. **Hyderabad, Telangana**
nodes.summary: 24x7 ATMs at Hyderabad railway stations Secunderabad Junction (SC) and Hyderabad Deccan (Nampally) (HYB), and at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport.

nodes.title: 5. **Chennai, Tamil Nadu**
nodes.summary: 24x7 ATMs at Chennai railway stations Chennai Central (MAS) and Chennai Egmore (MS), and at Chennai International Airport.

nodes.title: 6. **Kolkata, West Bengal**
nodes.summary: 24x7 ATMs at Kolkata railway stations Howrah Junction (HWH), Sealdah (SDAH) and Kolkata Railway Station (KOAA), and at Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport.

nodes.title: 7. **Pune, Maharashtra**
nodes.summary: 24x7 ATMs at Pune Junction (PUNE) railway station and at Pune International Airport.

nodes.title: 8. **Ahmedabad, Gujarat**
nodes.summary: 24x7 ATMs at Ahmedabad Junction (ADI) railway station and at Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport.

nodes.title: 9. **Surat, Gujarat**
nodes.summary: 24x7 ATMs at Surat Railway Station (ST) and at Surat Airport.

nodes.title: 10. **Jaipur, Rajasthan**
nodes.summary: 24x7 ATMs at Jaipur Junction (JP) railway station and at Jaipur International Airport.

nodes.title: 11. **Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh**
nodes.summary: 24x7 ATMs at Lucknow Charbagh (LKO / LJN) railway station and at Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport.

nodes.title: 12. **Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh**
nodes.summary: 24x7 ATMs at Kanpur Central (CNB) railway station and at Kanpur Airport (Chakeri).

nodes.title: 13. **Nagpur, Maharashtra**
nodes.summary: 24x7 ATMs at Nagpur Junction (NGP) railway station and at Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar International Airport.

nodes.title: 14. **Indore, Madhya Pradesh**
